title: 第3章 神秘老头（上）

content_zh:
此时，月亮升上了天空，经过了阳顶天头顶的天空，他清晰地看到有两个月亮。
苏东坡的词中写着但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。但是现在，阳顶天和父母亲人所看到的月亮都不是同一个了，甚至这里还有两个月亮。
悲伤和疲倦侵袭着阳顶天，他朝不远处的老头望去一眼，老头依旧闭目一动不动。
到了这个境地，也没什么害怕的了。于是，阳顶天也缓缓闭上双目，沉沉睡去。
再次醒过来，又是几十个小时之后。
阳顶天想要起来，继续找出去的办法，寻找离开洞穴的路，却发现自己完全站不起来了。接连几天几夜的饥饿已经让他身上的能量完全消耗殆尽了，那储存了几十年的热量，为了救出那老头融化那根刺寒冰柱而消耗得干干净净。
这几天几夜中，阳顶天只喝过几口冰融化的水，没有进过一口食物，还流了很多血，此时想要站起来，真的连一点点力气都没有了。
此时外面的天空阴沉沉的，没有太阳，乌云一层一层地压上来。
紧接着，天空开始下雪，拳头一般大的雪团猛地从天空洒下来。没过一会儿，大雪将整个洞穴底部铺了厚厚的一层。老头依旧闭目一动不动，渐渐地整个身体完全被大雪覆盖，差不多一个小时后，老头整个身体已经都看不到了，变成了一个雪人。
而阳顶天身上的积雪也开始渐渐厚起，他身上的热量此时甚至已经无法融化积雪了。
为了不被大雪掩埋，阳顶天用力甩头。但是没过一会儿，又被积雪掩盖，阳顶天再次甩头。
一次，两次，三次……
最后，阳顶天连甩头的力气都没有，身体彻底流失了最后一丝热量，眼睁睁看着积雪将自己彻底掩埋，也将自己的生命彻底掩埋。
忽然，前面不远处的老头身上的积雪一抖，老头动了。他伸手进怀中，掏出一颗红色的东西朝着阳顶天的方向扔过来。
是一颗红色的药丸，药丸落在积雪上，周围的积雪顿时瞬间融化，在雪白的积雪上，红色的药丸如同火焰一般刺目。
此时，阳顶天求生的意志让他涌起了最后一点力气，身躯猛地扑了上去，张嘴咬住了那颗红色的药丸。
至于会不会是毒药？吃下去会有什么后果？阳顶天完全不理会了。
那颗药丸刚刚入嘴，顿时如同烈火一般在嘴里化开，如同流动的火焰一般钻进腹中，然后一股热量散发开来，流入全身的血脉。
顿时，仿佛春天的暖日普照大地一般，阳顶天僵硬的身躯开始一寸一寸地复苏。
很快，整个身体重新变成了腾腾燃烧的火炉，完全恢复了活力。甚至，还有一股强大的力量在体内横冲直撞，拼命地想要迸发而出，阳顶天只觉得浑身有用不完的力气。

“这是什么东西？竟然这么神奇？”阳顶天惊讶兴奋，然后走到老头的面前鞠躬道：“谢谢您，老先生！”
“不过，您的身体也抗不住了，您不吃一颗吗？”阳顶天问道。
老头没有理会他，依旧闭目垂坐，任由积雪落在身上，重新将自己裹成一个雪人。
接下来，阳顶天不管说什么，对方都没有任何回应。
浑身充满了热量的阳顶天不知道应该做什么，这个洞穴就那么大，他在大雪中胡乱挥舞了一顿拳头，完全是舞得乱七八糟。
大雪越下越大，短短半天就堆了两尺左右，几乎将那老头完全掩埋了，所以阳顶天每经过半个小时，就过去为老头清理身上的积雪一次。
“这雪下得那么大，堆起来那么快，只怕再过几年就会将洞穴堆满了。”阳顶天暗道。
紧接着他不由得一阵狂喜，然后冲向老头道：“老先生，老先生，我找到出去的办法了，我找到出去的办法了。”
但是老头依旧没有任何回应。
阳顶天确实找到了出去的办法了，他可以用积雪做成台阶粘冻在寒冰洞壁上，这洞口大约有几千米深，冰雪台阶环绕而上，大概需要做几万个。
说做就做，阳顶天先用积雪压成一个一尺长，半尺宽，三寸厚的雪砖，然后将这块雪砖压粘在寒冰洞壁上，用自己的身体将雪砖融化成水，然后凝结成冰，雪砖就变成了小一号的冰砖，牢牢地黏在洞壁上。

content_en:
At this time, the moon rose into the sky and passed through the sky above Yang Dingtian. He clearly saw two moons.
Su Dongpo's poem says that he hopes that people will live forever and share the beauty of the moon thousands of miles apart. But now, the moon seen by Yang Dingtian and his parents and relatives is not the same one. There are even two moons here.
Sadness and fatigue invaded Yang Dingtian. He glanced at the old man not far away. The old man still closed his eyes and remained motionless.
Now that we are in this situation, there is nothing to be afraid of. Then, Yang Dingtian slowly closed his eyes and fell into a deep sleep.
When I woke up again, it was dozens of hours later.
Yang Dingtian wanted to get up and continue to find a way out, looking for a way out of the cave, but found that he could not stand up at all. The hunger for several days and nights had completely exhausted all the energy in his body. The heat stored for decades was completely consumed in order to save the old man and melt the stinging icicle.
In the past few days and nights, Yang Dingtian had only drank a few sips of melted ice water, not eaten a morsel of food, and had lost a lot of blood. At this time, he really didn't have any strength to stand up.
At this time, the sky outside was gloomy, there was no sun, and dark clouds were pressing up layer by layer.
Immediately afterwards, it started to snow, and snowballs as big as fists suddenly rained down from the sky. After a while, heavy snow covered the bottom of the cave with a thick layer. The old man remained motionless with his eyes closed, and gradually his whole body was completely covered by the heavy snow. After almost an hour, the old man's whole body was no longer visible and turned into a snowman.
The snow on Yang Dingtian's body began to gradually thicken, and the heat on his body could no longer even melt the snow.
In order not to be buried in the heavy snow, Yang Dingtian shook his head hard. But after a while, it was covered by snow again, and Yang Dingtian shook his head again.
Once, twice, three times...
In the end, Yang Dingtian didn't even have the strength to shake his head. His body completely lost the last trace of heat, and he watched helplessly as the snow completely buried him and his life.
Suddenly, the snow on the old man not far ahead shook, and the old man moved. He reached into his arms, took out a red object and threw it in the direction of Yang Dingtian.
It was a red pill. The pill fell on the snow, and the surrounding snow melted instantly. On the white snow, the red pill was as dazzling as a flame.
At this time, Yang Dingtian's will to survive gave him the last bit of strength, and he rushed forward, opening his mouth to bite the red pill.
As for whether it could be poison? What are the consequences of eating it? Yang Dingtian ignored it completely.
As soon as the pill entered the mouth, it immediately melted in the mouth like a fire, penetrated into the abdomen like a flowing flame, and then a heat spread out and flowed into the blood vessels of the whole body.
Suddenly, as if the warm spring sun was shining on the earth, Yang Dingtian's stiff body began to revive inch by inch.
Soon, the whole body turned into a burning furnace again, completely restored to vitality. There was even a powerful force rushing through his body, desperately trying to burst out. Yang Dingtian felt that his whole body had endless strength.
"What is this? Is it so magical?" Yang Dingtian was surprised and excited, then walked up to the old man and bowed: "Thank you, old sir!"
"However, your body can't resist it anymore. Why don't you take one?" Yang Dingtian asked.
The old man ignored him and still sat down with his eyes closed, letting the snow fall on his body and wrapping himself into a snowman again.
Next, no matter what Yang Dingtian said, there was no response from the other party.
Yang Dingtian, who was full of heat, didn't know what to do. The cave was so big. He waved his fist randomly in the heavy snow, dancing completely in a mess.
The snow fell heavier and heavier, and it piled up about two feet in just half a day, almost covering the old man completely.It was buried, so Yang Dingtian would go over and clean the snow off the old man's body every half hour.
"The snow is falling so hard and piling up so quickly. I'm afraid the cave will be filled up in a few years." Yang Dingtian said secretly.
Then he couldn't help but feel a burst of ecstasy, and then rushed to the old man and said: "Old sir, old sir, I found a way out, I found a way out."
But the old man still didn't respond.
Yang Dingtian has indeed found a way out. He can use snow to make steps and stick them to the wall of the ice cave. The entrance is about several kilometers deep, and tens of thousands of ice and snow steps are needed to go up.
He did as he was told. Yang Dingtian first pressed the snow into a snow brick that was one foot long, half a foot wide, and three inches thick. He then pressed the snow brick onto the wall of the ice cave, melted the snow brick into water with his own body, and then solidified it into ice. The snow brick turned into a smaller ice brick and stuck firmly to the cave wall.
